notes.title: Quick update, Nice features and Bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Quick new update for all the Ele-mentallers[/h2]

Added edge warnings for enemies. You will now see a glow at the edge of the screen letting you know the enemy Ele-ment that's coming in.

Extra player ship particles.

When over-turbed, players turn into a Ele-Mental wreck, unable to change Ele-Ment until back up and running at full power.

Swapped a couple of the unlockable skins around.

Fixed a few sneaky bugs.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2!
notes.notes:
[h3]The one of a kind fast paced hardcore arcade action multiplayer quick thinking ele-ment absorbing mental workout for everybody is back with a huge upgrade.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved Graphics.
[*] Tighter Collisions.
[*] Rebalanced unlockable costs and earned Coins.
[*] Win medals for higher scores
[*] Complete missions fast for par.
[*] New Legend LeaderBoards
[*] Create and save all the custom levels you could ever want.
[*] Create custom 8 stage arcade machines with your levels.
[*] Create custom 10 stage survival decathalons with your levels.
[*] Mix 4 tunes by yourself now.
[*] Improved Audio.
[*] 2 Extra tunes.
[*] Resolution and anti-alias selection.
[*] All bugs fixed!
[/list]

notes.title: New Update Coming Very Soon.
notes.notes:
That Free DLC we mentioned....

So a few days after the last announcement, the lead developer had a cardiac arrest and was in a coma for a bit.
Thankfully he pulled through and was back on his feet and back to health fairly rapidly.

As there are only 2 of us this took it's toll on developments, but things have still been ticking along.

Long story short, It's all done and we are in the testing stage.

As well as improved graphics there are a bunch of new features.

* Survival now has Medals to earn from reaching score targets.
* Missions now have Par times, beat these to earn more coin.
* Name and Save any number of missions and survival levels in the creator.
* Create custom Marathons and Arcades using your saved levels.
* The general economy of the game has been overhauled, you will now earn more coins and many 
   unlockables are cheaper.
* Survival and Arcade doors are open from the start now, not just the missions.
* 5 Arcades are available from the start with 5 more to unlock.
* Arcade progress saved, come back later to continue if you are struggling.

We also tracked down the mysterious not colliding with any enemies bug that happened very infrequently. Sorted.

Free update coming very soon. 

Have a great day!
